scope: Local payer API in the actual Rust BFT Node, accepted immutable Circle pool, real Groth16 proofs, signed local canonical QCs and encrypted note/intent storage. No native transaction submission service, withdrawal API or network/private-kernel qualification is claimed.
implemented: Shared encrypted SQLite record storage with distinct operator/payer scopes; fresh receiving slots persist before their addresses are returned
Generic canonical note-placement verifier retains before/after code/VK/parent, custody, math/value-rule, QC, creation-interval and Merkle membership checks
Payer imports real private notes only after ownership/view opening and canonical placement validation; untrusted public indexes must match current canonical notes/spent roots and count
Independent current directory consent binds operator, generation, receipt key, tariff/class, price/byte ceilings, pool and signed private payout owner
Durable finite intent reserves one or two existing notes and a change key before local proving; accepted limits and relayer cannot silently change on retry
Local proving key must match the accepted VK; each produced proof is verified locally; no witness or spend key leaves in the native calldata
Unchanged-root retry returns the same persisted public proposal after encrypted wallet restart
Rebase retains exactly the same inputs and change slot; a competing canonical append makes the exposed old proof unusable and old calldata is explicitly refused by the native transaction builder
Operator eligibility and pool roots are rechecked under one publication before a proposal is returned
Canonical expected output placement and actual input nullifiers finalize purchase; early-imported change retains any later reservation instead of being reset

Cancellation refuses an exposed current-root proof; canonical root invalidation plus definitely unspent inputs permits release before expiry. Expiry alone does not release an exposed current-root proof
Already paid or cancelled/expired intents cannot create another debit; available OCT excludes reserved or canonically spent notes

native.scope: Pristine inventoried VM synchronous/stepped/worker proof verification and AML emission. No full upstream epoch or public deployment claim.

prior_fixture_failures.cause: The success-only fixture was used to publish intentionally stale proof calldata, which the native builder correctly refused.
prior_fixture_failures.fix: Explicitly assert that the exact stale transaction is refused, held/accepted lists are empty, and the committed node head/pool remain unchanged.

prior_fixture_failures.cause: After the extended payer flow advanced time, the existing final expiry test selected only one additional second, below the adopted ten-second minimum.
prior_fixture_failures.fix: Advance at least ten seconds and align the helper expiry to whole seconds. The protocol timing rule is unchanged.

remaining: Private quote/receipt RPC protocol, authenticated idempotent issuance, native submission/recovery and routed payer/client journals
Native withdrawal/cancellation transactions, note consolidation, operator earnings custody handoff and shared multi-operator payer views
Zero-price grants, private service-equivocation claims, sponsored-payment and mixed-spend adversarial qualification
Automatic key custody/backup tooling and production proving-key ceremony/review
Funded private multi-node/kernel/restart/ExEx qualification and public devnet/mainnet/alternate-host parity gates
limits: Payer is currently a local Rust node API for an accepted operator source; no remote payer endpoint, broadcast or released private traffic runner is enabled
Available wallet notes are not a public withdrawable channel balance; a pending exposed proof keeps its inputs reserved until safely invalidated or finalized
One purchase uses at most two notes; fragmented balances may require consolidation, whose wallet API is not yet implemented
Existing private note proofs permit generic transfers/withdrawals, but automatic operator-income-to-payer custody and native withdrawal APIs remain unfinished
A prepared proposal, local status or RPC acknowledgement proves neither payment nor physical delivery
Test setup entropy is not a production ceremony. Keys are separately supplied; privileged database/meter rollback or cloned copies are not detected
Released shielded_required routes remain refused before loading keys/journals
No deployment, public source compilation or GitHub push in this stage

macos_build_env.note: Command-scoped existing toolchain; no global Xcode setting or license acceptance changed
